title: EE1A1 Modifications
projectDescription: Analysis of eEF1A1 posttranslational modifications of Mocetinostat-treated and non-treated control cells
sampleProcessingProtocol: IPs were separated by SDS-PAGE, the area in which eEF1A1 should run was excised and proteins in-gel digested with trypsin.
dataProcessingProtocol: Data were processed by MaxQuant version 1.6.2.10 using a full-length mouse Uniprot databas (version April 2016).
